# Third-party images that are not Docker Hub official images, copied to
# ghcr.io/miwi35/mirror/<target> by .github/workflows/mirror-images.yml (weekly
# and on demand). CI and the e2e stack pull the copy, never Docker Hub, whose
# anonymous pull limit took CI down twice (9–10 Oct.). An official image needs no
# line here: use public.ecr.aws/docker/library/<name>:<tag>.
#
# <target name:tag>          <source on Docker Hub>
# A source pinned by digest (@sha256:…) is copied at that digest, and the copy
# must keep it: the references pin the same digest.
wiremock:3.9.1               docker.io/wiremock/wiremock:3.9.1
mercure:v1.0.2               docker.io/dunglas/mercure:v1.0.2@sha256:e5d8f06a60f2feb5e91f7ba2046d9184f6339b3498b5d2f5adaeb5bcb080bfc7
buildkit:buildx-stable-1     docker.io/moby/buildkit:buildx-stable-1
